### Added
- **A codex Harness entry and its egress origins, per installation, off by default** (giantswarm/giantswarm#38552). A `kagent.harnesses` entry takes `runtime: codex`: the kagent chart renders a Harness on its codex-harness image at the published digest, with the entry's own name, snapshot location and env and no limits, beside a claude one. The entry's origins, the installation's forge and git hosts, go under `agent-manager.harness.egress.<Harness name>`: agent-manager writes them into a codex agent's `spec.egress`, the Substrate egress gate refuses every other origin with a 403, and kagent adds the model destination itself. kagent refuses a share of a Session on a codex Harness, as on every coding Harness. Nothing renders without the values. `values.yaml` shows the entry, `ci/test-coding-agents-values.yaml` carries a codex entry beside the claude one with both egress lists, and `make verify-kagent-harness` and `make verify-components-charts` assert the forwarded entries, the codex Harness at the chart's codex-harness digest against the pinned Harness CRD, and agent-manager's egress map with an entry for every coding Harness.
### Changed
- **`components.kagent.versionRange` and `components.kagent-crds.versionRange` are `>=1.13.0 <1.14.0` (were `>=1.12.0 <1.13.0`), and the customer BOM pins kagent 1.13.0: a `harnesses[]` entry runs the codex runtime** (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#606). The kagent chart publishes the codex-harness image and stamps its digest into `runtimeImages.codexHarness`, and a `harnesses[]` entry takes `runtime: codex`; the 1.12 chart refused it. The codex runtime reports a turn's usage on its final task status (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#610). The release also publishes the omp-harness image, which no `harnesses[]` runtime selects yet. Same upstream pin, no CRD, API or persisted-format change: Substrate stays on 1.11.4, and every conversation carries over (UPGRADE.md).
